title: Say Wall
style: Deep house with new age textures; warm pads, rounded bass, glass bells and distant wordless choir, shifting synth arpeggio; dry, close spoken exchanges with warm mid-range male and female leads trading clipped, rhythmic staccato phrases; soft shifting 122 BPM four-on-the-floor, kick cut in the breakdown and restored beneath the final call-and-response chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Glass Bells, Filtered Kick]

[male:]
The wall is new every moment.

[female:]
There’s no such thing as a moment.

[male:]
You know what I mean.

[Verse 1]
[male:]
We walked past Macondo in the dark.
I thought those stones would never move.
I took the steps that Zeno taught me.
Halfway again. I never got through.

[female:]
You said “never” twice just now.
Careful what you build with that.

[male:]
It’s just a figure of speech.

[female:]
So is the wall.

[Chorus]
[male:]
Say wall, say wall.

[female:]
What do you see?

[male:]
I see a tower.

[female:]
I see a seam.

[male:]
Same word, same word.

[female:]
Say it again.

[male:]
I think I know what you mean.

[female:]
Which wall are you in?

[Instrumental Drop]
[Glass Bell Hook, Wordless Choir]

[Verse 2]
[female:]
We built our Babel to the clouds.
You thought that God would meet us there.

[male:]
Or we could climb the whole way up
And say we found nobody there.

[female:]
You’d write that word with a capital G.

[male:]
Depends which god you mean.

[female:]
Back to the wall, then.

[Pre-Chorus]
[male:]
“I think, therefore I am,” you say.
I know the words. I say them too.

[female:]
We say them in the same old tongue.
What does that “I” mean to you?

[Chorus]
[male:]
Say wall, say wall.

[female:]
What do you see?

[male:]
I see a tower.

[female:]
I see a seam.

[male:]
Same word, same word.

[female:]
Say it again.

[male:]
I think I know what you mean.

[female:]
Which wall are you in?

[Breakdown]
[Spoken Dialogue, Kick Drops Out]

[male:]
What are you doing down there?

[female:]
Down where?

[male:]
I thought you’d fallen.

[female:]
I thought you’d climbed.
Where would the bottom be?

[male:]
Then why call it a wall?

[female:]
I had to call it something.

[Final Drop]
[Full Groove, Alternating Vocals]

[male:]
Say wall, say wall.

[female:]
What do you see?

[male:]
Maybe it’s language.

[female:]
Maybe it’s everything.

[male:]
Same word, same word.

[female:]
Say it again.

[male:]
I think I know what you mean.

[female:]
Which wall are you in?

[Outro]
[Spoken Dialogue Over Fading Bells]

[female:]
What connects science and philosophy?

[male:]
Someone told me mathematics.

[female:]
Who told you?

[male:]
Does it matter?

[female:]
Maybe. Maybe not.
